newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BENKENSTEIN CRACKS CENTURY AGAINST F.STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENKENSTEIN CRACKS CENTURY AGAINST F.STATE.

text.p: Natal captain Dale Benkenstein hammered a confident century against Free State on Friday, but then saw his side fail to build a large total as they were bowled out for 282 in their first innings.

When bad light stopped play 7.1 overs early, Free State were 16 for one in their reply, having lost the key wicket of captain Gerhardus Liebenberg for one. Former South African test bowler Tertius Bosch made the breakthrough.
Benkenstein top-scored for Natal with a fluent 100 in just 129 balls on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series match at Kingsmead on Friday.

The 22-year-old reached his fourth first-class century -- and his second in this season's Supersport Series -- before edging a Chris Craven leg-cutter to be caught behind by wicketkeeper Philip Radley.
The Natal captain, playing positively throughout, struck 15 fours and two sixes during a stay at the crease of just over three hours.
He and all-rounder Neil Johnson (50) shared in a fifth-wicket stand of 133 during the afternoon session as Natal recovered from a shaky 86 for four at lunch.
The pair came together after Natal lost the wicket of Jonty Rhodes (33) in unfortunate circumstances off the last ball of the morning session.

Rhodes, who had batted confidently in a bid to impress the national selectors, was given out leg before wicket to the slow left-arm of Nicky Boje by umpire Danny Becker -- despite sweeping the ball off the full face of the bat.
But the home side, having reached the promising platform of 219 for four through the efforts of Benkenstein and Johnson, then lost their way as their last six wickets fell for a further 63 runs.

Sarel Cilliers, Bradley Player and Nico Pretorius all took two wickets apiece in a Free State attack without the services of Franklyn Stephenson (who had a pulled hamstring) from midway through the afternoon.
Bowling: Cilliers 14-3-42-2, Stephenson 11.3-4-27-1, Player 16.1-2-47-2, Pretorius 13-2-61-2, Boje 13-4-47-1, Venter 10-4-28-1, Craven 6-2-20-1.
Bonus points: Natal - three: Free State - four.
To bat: K.Venter, C.Craven, N.Boje, F.Stephenson, B.Player, P.Radley, N.Pretorius, S.Cilliers.
